hide_when_inactive.label: Hide when inactive
hide_when_inactive.description: Show the icon only while passwordless sudo is on, like Omarchy. Use the control center tile or IPC to turn it on.

show_countdown.label: Show countdown
show_countdown.description: Show the time left next to the icon while a timed grant is active.

panel.title: Passwordless sudo
panel.status_off: Off. sudo asks for your password.
panel.status_external: On, granted by another sudoers rule
panel.prompt: How long should passwordless sudo stay enabled?
panel.change_prompt: Change how long it stays enabled
panel.external_note: Passwordless sudo comes from a sudoers rule this plugin did not create, so it cannot turn it off. Edit /etc/sudoers.d to remove it.

warning.title: Significant security risk
warning.body: Any process running as your user can run any command as root without a password {span}.
warning.agents: This is useful for AI agents that need sudo, but anyone or anything with access to your account gets full root.
warning.expiry_timed: It turns off automatically after {span}, even if the machine reboots before then.
warning.expiry_permanent: It stays on across reboots until you turn it off.

notify.title: Passwordless sudo
notify.enabled_timed: Enabled. It will automatically turn off in {span}.
notify.enabled_permanent: Enabled permanently. Click the bar icon to turn it off.
notify.disabled: Disabled. sudo asks for a password again once any cached authorization expires.
notify.still_external: Your grant was removed, but another sudoers rule still allows sudo without a password.
notify.not_authorized: Authentication failed or not authorized. Your account must be an administrator (wheel group).
notify.enable_failed_body: Check the Noctalia log for details.
